scenario: Autónomo, income 50,000, expenses 4,000, SS 3,600, VC, foreign clients only. Each calculation below carries its own oracle, because the annual cuota íntegra and the quarterly advances are checked against different sources.

modelo130.oracleRef: Theory §7.3, ed. 2: Example B quarter by quarter (cumulative income, expenses and payable per quarter, Σ 8,480). The theory table applies no minoración, so previousYear is set above the last band.

rentaTrueUp.oracleRef: Theory §7.2, ed. 2, Example B steps 1–10 for the inputs and the cuota íntegra estatal of 5,324.75 − 527.25 = 4,797.50. The theory takes the VC cuota as 5,250.00 − 499.50, applying the state mínimo of 5,550 to the regional scale; LIRPF art. 56.3 and 74.1 (boe.es consolidated Ley 35/2006, read 2026-09-26) apply the region's own mínimo instead, which for VC is 6,105 (Ley 13/1997 art. 2 bis.1.a, boe.es consolidated BOE-A-1998-8202, read 2026-09-26; AEAT Manual práctico Renta 2025, cap. 14, Comunitat Valenciana: importes del mínimo personal y familiar). So the VC cuota is 5,250.00 − 549.45 = 4,700.55, the cuota íntegra 9,498.05, and with Σ 130 of 8,480.00 the result is 1,018.05 a ingresar (#29). With no employment income the whole cuota is the activity's, so liabilityOnActivity is the cuota íntegra and gap is the result. marginalRate is not in the theory; it is the tranche rates at a base of 40,400 (0.185 estatal + 0.175 VC).
